integrity: Symbolic theorem stress-tested by a separate exhaustive program covering of all labeled maps in finite dimensions one through four; no infinite proof is inferred from enumeration.
limitations: Full nonzero compatibility frames of complete atomic Boolean algebras only, target has two atoms; no results for nonatomic Boolean algebras, proper induced subframes or higher-atom targets; no restricted-valuation transfer asserted.
title: Binary p-morphism rigidity for atomic Boolean compatibility frames
